text:
jordan: Hey folks — small PR to normalise a couple of exported consts and fix an import order nit. CI is red because of gofmt/staticcheck. Would appreciate a quick look so I can merge before the release cut.

PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/2840

jordan: Offending snippet was basically:
```
// old
const MAX_PREFETCH = 8
const Default_Tokens = 1024

// new (what I changed)
const MaxPrefetch = 8
const DefaultTokens = 1024
```

jordan: I know it's a little noisy — staticcheck complained about the underscore and gofmt reordered imports, so I fixed both and squashed into a single commit.

ben: quick glance — the rename from `MAX_PREFETCH` -> `MaxPrefetch` is fine for the package if it's intentionally exported. Are those used outside the package? if not, make them unexported to avoid churn.

jordan: good call. They are referenced from runtime/kvcache and eng-runtime tests. so need to stay exported for now. I added a brief comment to avoid accidental change: `// exported for runtime/kvcache usage`.

maria: CI failure was also the import group order in `pkg/serve/handler.go` — goimports put external cloud libs before stdlib. I pushed a tiny commit to reorder and ran `gofmt -w .` locally, seems green for me.

ci-bot: build status: Checks failed -> re-run requested by maria

ci-bot: build status: All checks passed (linux, mac, windows), 3m 12s

ben: nice. left one tiny nit: `DefaultTokens` reads a bit generic — can we name it `DefaultMaxTokens` to be explicit? not a blocker tho.

jordan: `DefaultMaxTokens` sgtm, will rename in this PR. keeps clarity.

alex: if CI is green and ben/maria are fine, I'm happy to approve. :shipit:

ben: LGTM :+1:

maria: Approved. :thumbsup:

jordan: thanks all — squashed and pushed one more time. merging now. will follow up if anything else flaps during the release smoke tests.

alex: thanks for moving quick, Jordan.

jordan: np — ping me if you see any regression in kvcache tests. I ran the local suite but appreciate extra eyes.
